title: Late Delivery + Broken Item - Customer Demands Instant Refund

raw_content.initial_message: This order arrived late AND it’s broken. I’m not doing exchanges or return nonsense. Just refund me right now.
raw_content.context: Customer has multiple issues: delivery delay + damaged item. Policy: apologize, confirm order details, explain refund constraints (refund after return initiated/pickup scan), offer expedited pickup and replacement option, and set timeline. Avoid arguing, focus on an action plan.

learning_objectives: Handle multi-issue complaint without sounding overwhelmed
De-escalate and prioritize next best action
Follow refund policy but still provide a satisfying plan
correct_sop_steps: Acknowledge both issues (late + broken) and apologize
Confirm order details and delivery date
Request minimal evidence politely if required (photo of damage)
Explain refund constraint: refund begins once pickup/return is initiated (no instant refund if policy disallows)
Offer immediate actions: expedited return pickup today/tomorrow and priority replacement option
Set clear next update time and summarize plan in one message
Offer escalation to supervisor if customer refuses any resolution path
common_mistakes: Only addressing one issue (late OR broken) and ignoring the other
Sounding like you’re doubting the damage claim
sticky_notes: KEY: Validate both problems first, then give 1 clear plan.
TRAP: Do not debate refund instantly—move to pickup initiation + timeline.
HINT: The customer calms down when they see immediate action (pickup scheduled).

bonus_points: Gives a single concise summary message
Offers goodwill credit if policy allows (optional)

escalation_triggers: Any implication they caused the damage
customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will cooperate if you schedule pickup immediately and give a firm refund timeline with minimal back-and-forth
